facts.fact: The Supreme Court of Senegal's ordinance n°11/2026 treats law n°2025-15 on access to information as applicable, citing its article 29 and its 15-day time limit for answering requests.
facts.system: Loi n°2025-15 relative à l'Accès à l'Information

facts.fact: By ordinance n°11/2026 of 16 April 2026 the Supreme Court (2nd administrative chamber) declared inadmissible a summary request for the political funds figures made under law 2025-15, because the applicant had not first seized the CONAI.
